checkpoint: Condition on ambient rank one after fixed k0. H2 and b1_safe=(N-k0)-H2 are exact current-state counts. No per-configuration O(N^2) b2 enumeration is performed.
clustered_draw: permutation[k0] is one common uniform update after the shared checkpoint prefix. From the identical safe successor, suffix stream tags 0x429b2c101 and 0x429b2c202 independently select one uniform site from permutation positions k0+1..N-1. The same prefix, common update and two suffix counters are shared by the paired orientations.

estimands.b2_survival_estimate: E[U | checkpoint rank1], U=(y1+y2)/2; common absorption sets y1=y2=0
estimands.clone_dependence_gap: E[B]-E[y1]E[y2], computed separately from b2 survival
estimands.defined_rate: common update remains rank one / rank-one checkpoint rows

covariance: Delete-one-batch covariance of the joint eight-vector [four b2 survival estimates, four clone-dependence gaps], block diagonal across independently generated sizes and fully coupled across orientations and estimands within size.
extension_rule: Extend to 100k only if all four gap estimates are positive and the covariance-weighted common gap is at least 3 standard errors above zero at each of N325 and N425. Otherwise stop.
claim_boundary: This pilot tests a one-common-update/one-site-per-clone branching language at one checkpoint per size. It does not estimate the exact microscopic b2 count, prove Markov closure or nonclosure at scale, or identify a continuum memory field.
